_comment: Drug rules for CKD safety checks. Drafted from public guidance (KDIGO CKD 2024, BNF-style renal dosing summaries). A DOCTOR OR PHARMACIST MUST REVIEW AND OWN THIS FILE before any real use. Doses are mg per day unless noted.

ramipril.name: Ramipril
ramipril.patient_label: a kidney-protecting blood pressure medicine (ACE inhibitor)
ramipril.monitor: Check potassium and creatinine 1-2 weeks after starting or changing the dose.

enalapril.name: Enalapril
enalapril.patient_label: a kidney-protecting blood pressure medicine (ACE inhibitor)
enalapril.monitor: Check potassium and creatinine 1-2 weeks after starting or changing the dose.

losartan.name: Losartan
losartan.monitor: Check potassium and creatinine 1-2 weeks after starting or changing the dose.

telmisartan.name: Telmisartan
telmisartan.monitor: Check potassium and creatinine 1-2 weeks after starting or changing the dose.

amlodipine.name: Amlodipine
amlodipine.patient_label: a blood pressure medicine (calcium channel blocker)

furosemide.name: Furosemide
furosemide.monitor: Check salts (sodium, potassium) and kidney function; dose depends on swelling.

spironolactone.name: Spironolactone
spironolactone.monitor: High risk of high potassium; check potassium within 1 week.

dapagliflozin.name: Dapagliflozin
dapagliflozin.patient_label: a kidney- and heart-protecting medicine (SGLT2 inhibitor)
dapagliflozin.monitor: Pause during vomiting, diarrhoea or other acute illness (sick-day rule); genital hygiene.

empagliflozin.name: Empagliflozin
empagliflozin.patient_label: a kidney- and heart-protecting medicine (SGLT2 inhibitor)
empagliflozin.monitor: Pause during vomiting, diarrhoea or other acute illness (sick-day rule); genital hygiene.

metformin.name: Metformin
metformin.monitor: Stop in acute illness or before contrast scans; review dose when eGFR falls below 45.

potassium_chloride.name: Potassium chloride
potassium_chloride.monitor: Needs close potassium monitoring in CKD.

ibuprofen.name: Ibuprofen
ibuprofen.patient_label: a pain-killer of the NSAID type

diclofenac.name: Diclofenac
diclofenac.patient_label: a pain-killer of the NSAID type

naproxen.name: Naproxen
naproxen.patient_label: a pain-killer of the NSAID type
